newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia & Upjohn introduces drug delivery device.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn introduces drug delivery device.

text.p: Pharmacia & Upjohn Inc said Friday its new system to deliver growth hormone to children is now commercially available.

The company said the Genotropin Pen 12 system provides greater dosing flexibility than a system it launched in 1996. The new system has all of the ergonomic and patient-friendly features of the previous generation, but allows for higher doses of the drug Genotropin, Pharmacia said.
An estimated 20,000 U.S. children receive treatment for growth hormone deficiency to help them reach their genetic height potential, the company said.
Pharmacia provides human health care and related products.
Its shares were up 1/4 Friday at 35-3/8.
